      id = "960048cf-7a56-50cf-8498-549f900770d8"

      $a1 = "operator co_await" fullword ascii
      $s1 = "uohlyatqn" fullword ascii
      $s2 = "index = [%d][%d][%d][%d]" fullword ascii
